title: Email newsletter
slide_intent: Teach designers to organize a newsletter around a lead event and smaller stories so a reader can tell where to enter and what to read next.
strategic_value: Sheffield Museums can give an exhibition a distinctive campaign color while keeping navigation and institutional details legible throughout the mailing.
demonstration: Two mail windows show successive portions of a newsletter. Bright margins surround the lead exhibition, then a curator story, workshop news and a dark contact footer.
practical_value: Give the lead exhibition a recognizable opening and reserve a separate module for the smaller news item.

content_islands.name: Opening view
content_islands.spec: Frame the first mail example with pink margins. Stack the seal, exhibition image, title, date and action above the next portrait.

content_islands.name: Continuation view
content_islands.spec: Align the second window with the first and continue the portrait into its article. Follow with a white News block and a dark green footer containing contact and subscription details.
